name: mixer
description: Mixer: voice-controlled development environment for local AI coding agents

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "npm run watch:protocol" "npm run watch:client" "npm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client:clean: npm run build:protocol:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@mixer/client
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names highlight,plugin,relay --prefix-colors yellow,green,blue "npm run build:highlight" "npm run build:plugin" "npm run build:relay"
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean && npm run build:relay:clean
scripts.build:server: npm run build:server-deps && npm run build --workspace=@mixer/server && npm run build --workspace=@mixer/cli
scripts.build:server:clean: npm run build:server-deps:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@mixer/server && npm run build:clean --workspace=@mixer/cli
scripts.build:app-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:client && npm run build:plugin
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/builtin-plugins && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mixer/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:app-deps:clean && cd packages/app && cross-env MIXER_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && npm run build --workspace=@mixer/desktop --
scripts.version: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: npm run build:server && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.release:beta:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:major && npm run release:push
scripts.release:beta:next: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:beta:next && npm run release:push
scripts.release:promote: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:promote && npm run release:push
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:major && npm run release:push
